name: com.lookprep/lookprep
title: LookPrep
description: Read-only LookPrep catalogue: lip looks, prices, stored demo simulations and a link to the web flow.

tools.name: list_lip_styles
tools.description: List the named lip looks LookPrep can show as a simulation, with a one-line summary, how consistently sources use the name, the demo amounts show_demo_look accepts (demo_amounts) and the look's page.

tools.name: get_lip_style
tools.description: Details of one named lip look: what the name usually describes, where sources disagree, what the simulation shows, the demo amounts (demo_amounts) and the cited sources.

style_id.description: Look id from list_lip_styles, for example russian or natural.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current LookPrep prices in USD before tax: the free first preview, the fixed packs and the custom price by number of looks (custom_selection.price_by_look_count and rule), and how paying works. Payment happens only on LookPrep's Stripe Checkout page, not through this tool.

tools.name: show_demo_look
tools.description: Before and after image links for a look on a stored demo face. amount must be one of the look's demo_amounts from list_lip_styles or get_lip_style (both cover lip-flip); an unknown amount is an error that lists them. The images were made in advance; nothing is created by this call and no photo is needed.

style_id.description: Look id from list_lip_styles, or lip-flip. Defaults to natural.

amount.description: One of the look's demo_amounts (list_lip_styles, get_lip_style), in its demo_unit. Defaults to its demo_default_amount.

face_id.description: Demo face id from available_faces. Defaults to one demo face.

tools.name: start_personal_preview
tools.description: A link into the LookPrep web flow with looks preselected: looks for one or more, style_id as a shortcut for one, neither for the plain flow. Returns the link, its price and an instruction. Give the link to the person, who confirms they are 18 or older, uploads their own photo, consents and pays on the page; never ask for their photo.

style_id.description: Shortcut for looks: [{ style_id }], one look at its standard setting. A look id from list_lip_styles, or lip-flip. Not with looks.

looks.description: Looks to preselect, in order: 1 to 32 items. The first 20 valid, distinct looks are kept (the largest pack); every other item is returned in dropped with the reason.

style_id.description: Look id from list_lip_styles, or lip-flip.

amount.description: One of the look's demo_amounts (list_lip_styles, get_lip_style): mL, or units for lip-flip. Defaults to the look's standard setting.
